publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The possibility of using ultrawideband signals for comparison of time keepers scales with subnanosecond error is discussed. The purpose of experiment described in this paper was the estimation of instability of the moment of fixing of time state of the signal which has come by the shortest way between the radiating ultrawideband antenna (UWBAN 1.1) and receiving ultrawideband antenna (UWBAN 3.1)

articleTitle: Attenuation and Phase Shift of 6-MM Electromagnetic Wave with Wide Frequency Band in Water-Drop Medium
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Description of experimental facilities for measurements of attenuation and phase shift in water-drop formation is presented. The experimental technique is based on multifrequency wideband measurements with synthesis of signal of spatial distribution of reflection along longitudinal axis and traditional scheme of transmission coefficient measurements. The multifrequency measurements and synthesis have been done in real-time. The apparatus consists of modules of scalar reflectometer of series P2-68 (R2). The desired information is extracted from the amplitude and position of the peak of reflection from metal plate fixed beyond the zone of water-drop structure and spatial transformation of transmission coefficient as function of frequency. Some results of experimental investigation of physical model of water-drop medium are presented.

Author Keywords: measurements of attenuation and phase shift

articleTitle: Vivaldi Antenna in the Ultrashort Impulse Operating Mode
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of experimental and theoretical investigation of a Vivaldi antenna in the pulse radiation mode are presented. The forms of radiated and received pulses on the base and cross polarization field components are obtained. The energetic relations between the components are calculated. The energetic characteristics and mutual coupling effects for various radiator shape, length and type of the excitation pulse are investigated

articleTitle: An Iterative Process for Solving Diffraction Problems on Periodic Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A general algorithm is created to solving diffraction problems by the method of Schwartz. The diffraction problem concerning a linear waveguide phase antenna array is solved

articleTitle: Method of Ultrawideband Linear Antenna Array Matching
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Using a linear waveguide-slot array with one input in the center on the left and on the right as an example, a method of ultra wideband matching a linear array was offered. The use of this method will solve the problem of array design with any number of radiators

articleTitle: Formation of Ultrashort Pulses by a Layer with Moving Boundaries
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: It is shown that approaching movement of medium boundaries is accompanied by iterative multiple reflections of waves and formation of squeezing pulses. The wave frequency within the pulse increases infinitely, the field energy in the pulse also in creases infinitely in the approximation of the unlimited powerful mechanism for the approach of the boundaries

articleTitle: Propagation of Short Pulses in Dielectric Media
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: For the first time, generalization of theoretical and experimental works on pulse propagation in different media (including the active ones) was given by L. A. Vainshtein 1976. Since then a lot of works have appeared, wherein such new classes of active media as the ferroelectric, semiconductive and superconductive ones are described. Thin films manufactured from active medium materials amplify electromagnetic waves (EMW) while they propagate through the films. EMW propagation through nonlinear films in antenna systems is also investigated. In survey, short pulse propagation is studied with the use of special space-time Green's function proposed by the author. On the same basis, Vainshtein has studied active media, wherein propagating signals are amplified due to the electron non-balanced energy state in atoms and molecules. To some extent, his results can be also used when studying propagation of short pulses in other active media, but in this case, methods of work have to be essentially changed. In the paper, the character of changes is illustrated on the example of ferroelectric media

articleTitle: Estimation of Time Delay and Ionosphere Parameters for Wideband Signal Reception
publicationTitle: 2006 3rd International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Joint estimation of wideband signal time delay and ionosphere integral electron concentration is considered provided that a priory information is used and multiple accumulation measurement data is realized. The possibilities of the measurement devices syntheses and adaptive compensation of signal distortions are shown
